summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment to its business combination agreement with WISeSat.Space, extending the outside date to October 31, 2026. The original BCA was signed November 9, 2025. This filing does not indicate termination, but the extension of the closing deadline amid a pending SPAC merger suggests potential closing risk. The F-4 registration statement remains filed. Watch for shareholder approval and whether the extension signals deal execution challenges or regulatory delays. No price or premium terms are stated in this excerpt.
